subject: Recap & MAP: alignment, owners, and target dates
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@novacorp.com>, Alan Wu <alan.wu@novacorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & MAP: alignment, owners, and target dates

Hi Olivia / Alan —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have the same view on scope, owners, and timing. Call notes below and a one-tab MAP attached (Novacorp_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Top pain & goals (as discussed)
- Latency spikes on inference during peak hours (search/recommendation pipeline) causing timeouts and customer friction.
- Current billable compute costs are high due to per-request cold starts and low GPU utilization.
- Goal: reduce P95 latency below 200ms for user-facing calls and cut per-token inference cost by ~30% while maintaining current accuracy.

Proposed pilot scope (2–4 week technical pilot)
- Redwood-hosted inference with dedicated capacity for your most critical model path.
- Focus metrics: P95 latency, throughput at 95th percentile traffic, cost per 1M tokens.
- Success criteria: P95 < 200ms in production-like load + <=10% quality delta on sampled prompts.

Owners & suggested milestones (quick dates to choose from)
- Novacorp exec sponsor: Alan Wu — finalize budget/approval (target: 2027-07-12)
- Novacorp technical lead: Olivia Chen — pilot signoff & test plan (target: 2027-07-08)
- Redwood pilot lead: Monica Patel — environment setup + onboarding (target: 2027-07-05)
- Redwood infra lead: Ben Carter — dedicated pool provisioning + baseline benchmark (target: 2027-07-07)

Next steps (please pick who owns each or propose alternate dates):
1) Monica to open pilot workspace and share test harness — by 2027-07-05 (ACTION: Monica)
2) Olivia to share representative traffic pattern, token mixes, and procurement contact — by 2027-07-02 (ACTION: Olivia)
3) Alan to confirm budget owners and target exec review date — by 2027-07-06 (ACTION: Alan)

Attachments: Novacorp_MAP_v1.xlsx (compact MAP table), pilot-scope-appendix.pdf (test cases + data sanitization notes).

If this alignment looks right I’ll push the MAP to the HubSpot deal and upload the Drive folder. Happy to shift any dates — call out what works.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0124

[Attachment: Novacorp_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)] [Attachment: pilot-scope-appendix.pdf (pdf)]

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@novacorp.com>

Cc: Alan Wu <alan.wu@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:04:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & MAP: alignment, owners, and target dates

Thanks Rishi — this looks good and clean. A few clarifications from our side:

- Confirming pilot scope sounds correct. We can start with the recommendation path (search ranking + autocomplete) — that’s where latency hurts us most.
- I’ll share the representative traffic dump and token mix by EOD Friday (2027-07-02).
- Procurement contact is Marissa Long in our procurement org (marissa.long@novacorp.com). She handles vendor onboarding and contract terms.

On dates: 2027-07-05 for onboarding looks fine. For exec review, Alan prefers mid-July — 2027-07-15 is the earliest slate he can present to the CTO and Finance.

Could you add a brief bullets section in the MAP that captures the data security/retention expectations? Our InfoSec will need that for vendor evaluation.

Olivia Chen
Head of Search & Recommendations
Novacorp
olivia.chen@novacorp.com

Hi Olivia + team —

Thanks — I uploaded an updated MAP (attached) with a short security & data handling appendix and explicit owners for each milestone. Highlights:
- Data retention: Redwood-hosted pilot will retain logs for 30 days by default; we can configure longer retention behind your KMS if required. See the "Data & Security" row in the MAP.
- Onboarding checklist: access to sample traffic, test account credentials, and procurement terms.
- Test plan: 3 phases (baseline bench, traffic replay, production shadow).

Updated milestones (sheet tab: Milestones v1)
- 2027-07-02: Novacorp shares traffic + procurement contact (Olivia)
- 2027-07-05: Redwood provisioning + test harness access (Monica)
- 2027-07-07: Baseline benchmark + smoke test (Ben)
- 2027-07-15: Exec review (Alan)
- 2027-07-22: Pilot completion & handoff

Attachments included: Novacorp_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated) — contains the Milestones, Owners, Acceptance Criteria, and a short Security appendix. Also attached pilot-scope-appendix.pdf with the test cases we plan to run.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/9342) and Drive folder with the MAP (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xYq-MAP-Novacorp). I’ve set view permissions for olivia.chen@novacorp.com.

If that looks good Olivia, I’ll mark the HubSpot tasks and schedule a 30-minute onboarding window for 2027-07-05.

Best,
Monica Patel
